title: Benefit Schedule for Air Travel: Wanderlane Traveller Club Tiers
content:
This section of the Wanderlane Traveller Club benefit schedule states the named benefits a tier grants around air travel. Free checked bags are the bags carried free on air bookings made while holding the tier. Priority boarding and priority check-in record whether each is granted by the tier. Lounge passes are the single-visit passes granted each membership year, and the guest allowance is the number of guests admitted with the member on one lounge visit. Companion vouchers are the vouchers granted each membership year.

## The schedule

| Basis | Blue | Silver | Gold | Platinum | Titanium | Ambassador |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Free checked bags | 0 | 0 | 1 | 1 | 2 | 2 |
| Priority boarding | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Priority check-in | No | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Lounge passes (each membership year) | 0 | 0 | 2 | 4 | 8 | 12 |
| Lounge guest allowance | 0 | 0 | 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 |
| Companion vouchers (each membership year) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 1 | 1 | 2 |

## Where each benefit begins

Wanderlane Blue and Wanderlane Silver carry none of these benefits: every figure on the schedule stands at 0 for both, and neither priority boarding nor priority check-in is granted.

Free checked bags begin at Wanderlane Gold, at 1 bag, and rise to 2 at Wanderlane Titanium and Wanderlane Ambassador. Priority boarding begins at Wanderlane Gold and priority check-in at Wanderlane Platinum. Lounge passes begin at Wanderlane Gold, at 2 passes each membership year, and rise through 4 and 8 to 12 at Wanderlane Ambassador; the guest allowance, however, still stands at 0 at Wanderlane Gold and begins at Wanderlane Platinum, at 1 guest, rising to 2 and then 3. Companion vouchers begin at Wanderlane Platinum, at 1 each membership year, stand at 1 again at Wanderlane Titanium, and reach 2 at Wanderlane Ambassador.
